description: Capabilities determine specialization — not display names. Each capability maps to the skills and deterministic operations that realize it.

capabilities.description: Capture significant decisions as immutable Architecture Decision Records.
Execute a test suite and report red/green results.
Author unit/integration/E2E/BDD tests from requirements and specifications.
Review code, architecture, dependencies, and secrets for security.
Branch, commit, PR, and merge with deterministic gates.
Inspect repository state for sanity and merge readiness.
Coordinate work between agents via the postoffice channel.
Intake a Professor instruction and trace it through delegation to results.
